import pathlib,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from common import digest,load,need,write_new
receipts={}
for name in ('tool-tests','preservation-command','reference-assessment','source-validation'):
    path=root/name/'receipt.json'; receipt=load(path)
    need(receipt['complete'] is True and type(receipt['returncode']) is int and receipt['returncode']==0,'Incomplete local capture')
    for item,value in receipt['sha256'].items(): need(digest(path.parent/item)==value,'Capture changed')
    receipts[name]={'returncode':receipt['returncode'],'receipt_sha256':digest(path)}
need('Ran 9 tests' in (root/'tool-tests'/'stderr').read_text() and '\nOK\n' in (root/'tool-tests'/'stderr').read_text(),'Final tool tests incomplete')
for name,origin in load(root/'TOOLS_ORIGIN.json').items(): need(digest(root/name)==origin['sha256'],'Copied helper changed')
need(load(root/'PRESERVATION_VERIFIED.json')['files']==1184,'Historical scope mismatch')
decision=load(root/'P4_B1_DECISION.json');need(decision['decision']=='BLOCKED' and all(v is False for k,v in decision.items() if k.endswith('_go')) and decision['b1_contents']['formally_closed'] is False,'Decision must remain blocked without formal closure')
assessment=load(root/'P4_B1_REFERENCE_ASSESSMENT.json')
need(assessment['references_sha256']==digest(root/'P4_B1_OBSERVED_REFERENCES.json'),'Reference binding mismatch')
write_new(root/'LOCAL_CHECKS.json',{'status':'PASS_SUPPLEMENT_TOOLS_ONLY','decision':'BLOCKED','observed_ns':time.time_ns(),'python':sys.version,'platform':sys.platform,'synthetic_tool_tests':9,'receipts':receipts,'historical_scoped_files_unchanged':1184,'raw_b1_evidence_verified_here':False,'p3_archive_or_rootfs_reexamined':False,'historical_b1_comparator_reexecuted':False,'historical_campaigns_reexecuted':False,'wheels_native_qualification_repeated':False,'docker_commands':0,'network_downloads':0,'packages_installed':0,'b1_contents_formally_closed':False,'build_go':False,'create_go':False,'start_go':False,'run_go':False,'pull_go':False,'import_go':False,'production_go':False})
print('PASS_SUPPLEMENT_TOOLS_ONLY; B1 formal review pending; overall BLOCKED')
